player_prompt.intro:
Udlaiva {color} emdlalweni we-Breakthrough. Udlaiva {direction} kwenkhani le-{board_size}x{board_size}.
Emzimbeni wakho, ungaqhuba ipiysi elilodwa ngendlela eyodwa kwela ngaphambili noma ngokwezintsimu kwela ngaphambili.
Ipiysi ingaqhuba ngokwezintsimu kuphela uma ipiysi yebutho bendawo likho khona, futhi ingaqhuba kuphela esikweni esikhona ngendlela eyodwa ngokwezintsimu.
Ngesikhathi sokwela esikweni esikhona ipiysi yebutho bendawo, udla ipiysi futhi ipiysi yebutho bendawo liyaphucwa ngendlela eyodwa kwenkhani.
Sebenzisa kucophelela kwa-UCI, t.f. [a2a3] ukudlaiva kuva kwa-a2 ku-a3.
* 'a' inahlanganisa na koloni elingodlula, '1' inekoloni eliphakeme (kutoka kwa-White).
* Koloni la-Blacks lifike kwenkhani (row 8 kwa-8x8). Koloni la-White lifike kwenkhani (row 1 kwa-8x8).
Umdlali wokuqala opipi yake iphinde iphike kwenkhani yebutho bendawo, udla. Uma amapipa akho ongezwe, udla.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Please use bracketed algebraic notation like [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Loko kuhamba akulandzeli imitsetfo ye-Breakthrough nobe akusiko kwakho.
